title: MijnMaak67
description: A perfect vanilia+ modpack to play with friends
body:
This is built for players who want the vanilla experience refined — optimized visuals, performance improvements, and multiplayer tools that make every world feel alive.
It’s lightweight, stable, and designed for seamless gameplay with friends while keeping the authentic Minecraft atmosphere intact.

✨ Features

Beautiful visuals – Iris + Sodium + Shaders deliver vibrant lighting and smooth performance.

Immersive experience – Emotecraft and 3D Skin Layers bring your character to life.

Smooth stability – Not Enough Crashes and CreativeCore ensure your adventures run flawlessly.

Communication ready – Simple Voice Chat and Voice Chat Interaction let you talk and collaborate naturally.

Media integration – WATERFrAMES and WATERMeDIA let you display images and videos directly in-game.

Touch & interaction support – TouchController expands play possibilities for every setup.

🧱 Perfect for

Small multiplayer communities and friends’ servers

Builders and creators who want shaders and cinematic visuals

Players who want vanilla+ performance without complexity
